page_title: ATM 2-0 VIL | Atletico Madrid v Villarreal 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Jose Munuera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' A yellow card for a tackle by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal). Jose Munuera doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

90+3' Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Luiz Junior. This effort didn't really trouble him.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The referee blows his whistle as Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) was too aggressive in his challenge.
87' The current number of corner kicks is 8:3.
84' Jose Munuera shows the yellow card to Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) for a heavy challenge.
83' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured David Hancko leaves the pitch to be replaced by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
81' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
79' Substitution. Georges Mikautadze makes his way off the pitch and Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) comes on as his replacement.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Cardona leaves the pitch and Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) comes on.
77' Robin Le Normand is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid).
76' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) replacing Matteo Ruggeri.
76' Substitution. Nicolas Gonzalez did his best and is replaced by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
73' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) sees a yellow card from Jose Munuera after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
71' Goal disallowed! Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) scores but Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
71' The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
70' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
66' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
66' Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

66' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
65' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Munuera didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Pape Gueye (Villarreal) for Thomas Partey.
64' Marcelino has decided to substitute Alberto Moleiro and he is replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
64' A substitution has been made. Nicolas Pepe is replaced by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal).
60' Villarreal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
57' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.
54' Villarreal fail to score from a corner as Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) leaps to collect the ball.
54' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. Villarreal earn a corner.
52' 2 - 0 Goal! Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) makes the score 2:0 after burying a close-range header in the top left corner after a good run and cross by Marcos Llorente.
51' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

49' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
48' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) brings an opponent down and Jose Munuera interrupts the game.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Diego Simeone probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid). He is replaced by Alexander Sorloth.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' OFF THE BAR! Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) strikes a brilliant shot towards goal from the free kick, but his effort rattles the crossbar.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jose Munuera stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
44' Koke (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
44' PENALTY APPEAL after Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
43' 1:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
40' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
40' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Munuera no option but to blow his whistle.
38' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
37' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
36' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
34' The resulting corner from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
33' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) commits a foul during an attacking move.
32' The foul by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Munuera.
31' Atl. Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
30' Atl. Madrid have a corner.
27' Atl. Madrid are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
24' Today's referee Jose Munuera rightly decides to book Dani Parejo (Villarreal) for his harsh tackle.
22' That was close by Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
19' The foul by Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) was seen by Jose Munuera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
18' The percentage of ball possession is – 75:25.
15' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
14' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
12' Atl. Madrid string together a series of short passes.

9' 1 - 0 Goal! Julian Alvarez plays in Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 1:0.
8' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
6' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
6' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
2' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
Jose Munuera will officiate today.
